item.title: Thinking at loud - Episode 1: Dream with the solution
item.author: xxxx
item.description:
Dreaming the solution

Have you ever been so involved into a problem for hours or even days that suddenly, you got it?! That feeling is very special, it comes from a lot of different ways. Maybe talking with another person about their problems, listening to music to relax or the most spectacular for me when it comes out of a dream. Has it happened to you?

Today or yesterday whenever it will posted this articule, I remembered how long time from the last time. I have to say too much.
